lucy: Noticed a cluster onboarding spike this morning in eu-west. Several warm-pool nodes stuck at 'keystore timeout' while privatelink NATs reported conntrack drops.

ops-bot: [ALERT] privatelink-euw conntrack_table_full x47 in 10m; keystore-exporter 504 x58. Trigger: warmpool-onboard-failures.

diego: paste from node-23: 
```
2026-03-25T09:03:02Z kubelet warmup: failed to pull keystore meta -> timeout
kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
keystore-exporter euw latency=1100ms status=504
```

frank: probable cause: keystore reindex started with longer retention window -> exporter QPS burst. NAT conntrack not sized for this spike. short options: bump nf_conntrack_max, apply exporter rate-limit, or pause non-critical audit streams.

lucy: Ops proposal: 1) bump conntrack_max on nat-euw by 2x for 4h, 2) push a 10m canary throttle to exporter (200rps burst 400), 3) open compliance exception for scoped retention rollback of exporter index to 30-60d.

security-bot: [REQ] retention rollback needs approval. attach justification and rollback plan.

diego: Commands for NAT bump: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=240000` and monitor `/proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_count`.

frank: cost note: 180d -> 60d rollback nets ~-$5k/mo in euw export/storage. include in ticket. if security denies, infra must implement batching/async export. estimate 2w dev.

lucy: I'll start the NAT bump now and spin a short incident channel if this doesn't drop within 15m. Keeping this thread for quick updates.

ops-bot: [INFO] conntrack_max updated on nat-euw fleet. initial count=172400.

frank: throttle canary config pushed to 1/5 exporter replicas: `rate=200rps burst=400 target=keystore-exporter`.

ops-bot: [METRIC] 5m after changes: conntrack_count=175900 -> growth slowed; exporter 504s down ~45%; warm-pool joins improved 26% -> 74%.

diego: Security pinged for scoped approval on COMPL-5019. Lucy, please add cost delta and re-audit plan.

lucy: done. If approval comes back slow, we'll keep throttle + conntrack bump and schedule exporter batching work. Also noting region fallback if euw unstable: divert new allocations to eu-central for 12-24h.

frank: follow-ups: PLAT-12011 implement exporter batching, PLAT-12012 async-export queue, OPS-12013 conntrack-runbook for big reindexes.

ops-bot: [RESOLVE] alert auto-suppressed after 30m. monitor for regressions.

lucy: closing thread for now. will attach logs & cost spreadsheet to COMPL-5019.
